Free voting on community proposals.

Fair Voting Logic

Voting is free and your staking badge determines your vote weight. Voting stays open for seven days. A proposal needs at least ten distinct wallets to vote and a weighted majority to pass.

Preventing Whale Manipulation

The quorum counts distinct wallets. Vote weights reflect staking badges.

Encouraging Engagement

Casting a vote costs zero $RIFT.

Solving Governance Issues

See active proposals and their results on the Governance page.

Proposals and voting are available in the app today.

See the Governance page for submission requirements.

Disclaimer

$RIFT is Riftn’s in-app currency. You can already use it inside Riftn. The on-chain token has yet to launch and has no official contract address or exchange listing.
